settings.value: Adult use; contains a blunt needle

settings.heading: Know the project before you start.
settings.note: Exact materials and time claims remain provisional until the physical sample passes.

settings.heading: Open only what you need.
settings.body: Color cards, canvas, tools, and the first-step sequence are organized before the box closes.

settings.heading: Follow one stitch path.
settings.body: Begin with a single diagonal tent stitch before any optional texture is introduced.

settings.heading: Recover without panic.
settings.body: The planned guide shows how to undo, restart, relax tension, and use the spare tools.

settings.heading: Made for the moment after “I think I messed it up.”
settings.note: Final tutorial steps will be approved only after observing a true novice use the production sample.

settings.question: What exactly is included?
settings.answer: The planned format includes one original printed canvas, pre-sorted thread with learning-room overage, one blunt tapestry needle, a threader, quick-start card, and original video help. Final contents will be confirmed from the physical sample.

settings.question: How long will it take?
settings.answer: We will not publish an exact time until a true novice completes the production sample without live coaching. The design target is a small project that can be finished across a few calm sessions.

settings.question: Is this safe for children?
settings.answer: The product is positioned for adults and contains a needle. Any future youth use guidance will follow final component review and clear supervision language.

settings.question: When will it ship?
settings.answer: No ship date has been promised. A dated fulfillment window will be posted before any preorder payment is accepted.
